title: UWell Caliburn G2 Replacement Pod
description:
Description
Specifications
Note: Sold as pairs.
The UWell Caliburn G2 Replacement Pod has a 2ml e-liquid capacity with an integrated coil. The UWell Caliburn G2 Replacement Pod features a top fill design, meaning you simply push the drip tip off the pod with your thumb.
It also has progressive airflow adjustment to offer mouth-to-lung & restricted direct-lung vaping. The UWell Caliburn G2 Replacement Pod is available in both 08.ohm and 1.2ohm resistances.
2ml E-liquid Capacity
Available in 0.8ohm and 1.2ohm
